mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2C9, reducing indomethacin metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while both drugs carry GI bleeding risk and disulfiram may potentiate NSAID-induced hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor for indomethacin toxicity signs (GI bleeding, renal dysfunction); consider alternative NSAID or pain management; if combination necessary, use lowest indomethacin dose with gastroprotection and periodic liver function tests.
